messages.subject: ME/7104/25 — response to section 109 notice of 8 January
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Cho,

Please find attached our client's response to the CMA's notice under section 109 of the Enterprise Act 2002 dated 8 January 2026, together with the indexed data room (folders 1–9, sent separately by secure transfer), a privilege log and a search-methodology statement. We confirm the response is complete and accurate to the best of Pennington's knowledge and belief.

We would welcome the opportunity to discuss the bidding analysis at the issues meeting.

Regards
James Osei

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0531
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
